reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Toner 250ml
reviews.text: It's very lightweight and absorbs faster than I expected. I have mix skin and personally I don't think I would recommend this product for dry skin as it's not very moisturizing.
reviews.zh: 佢好輕盈，吸收得比我想像中快。我係混合肌，個人就唔會推薦乾性肌用，因為佢保濕度唔算高。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Toner 250ml
reviews.text: Тонер өте жақсы әсер етті! Теріні сергітіп, тазалап, макияждан кейінгі қалдықтарды керемет түрде алып тастайды. Құрамы жұмсақ, тіпті сезімтал теріге де сай келеді. Қолданғаннан кейін тері балғын әрі тегіс болып қалады. Күнделікті күтімге таптырмас өнім!
reviews.zh: 呢支爽膚水效果超正！可以令皮膚醒神、清潔，仲可以好徹底咁卸走化妝後嘅殘留物。配方溫和，就連敏感肌都用得。用完之後皮膚變得清新又滑溜。日常護膚必備！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Toner 250ml
reviews.text: In love with this toner, my go-to toner forsure. Does exactly as it claims, I use it almost every day and night when I’m not using my exfoliating or brightening toners. I swear by this toner.
reviews.zh: 勁鍾意呢支爽膚水，實係我嘅daily必備。講到做到，唔係用緊去角質或者提亮爽膚水嘅日子，我日頭夜晚都會用。呢支爽膚水我真心推介。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Toner 250ml
reviews.text:
I am in love with this toner! I had a totally different skin routine prior to using this. I previously had an issue with acne and picking at it (I know it's bad, but I can't help it!). It's especially rough during my period.

However, after starting this (and using the RL Cica face wash) I've noticed that the redness on my existing acne diminished after a few weeks of use. After 3 months, I had less breakouts even during my period! I've been hooked ever since. 

I still use it to this day and hadn't had any huge acne (had small ones from time to time but it's better than the huge ones I had prior). I even converted friends to using this.

Overall, if you have bad acne like me and have tried others to diminish breakouts (believe me, I tried panoxyl, clean & clear, etc) try this line. It's gentle, effective and have actually helped lighten my hyperpigmentation from picking at my acne.
reviews.zh:
我完全愛上咗呢支爽膚水！用佢之前，我嘅護膚程序完全唔同。之前我一直有暗瘡問題，而且成日忍唔住擠暗瘡（我知道唔好，但真係忍唔住！），尤其係嚟m嗰陣更加嚴重。

不過，自從開始用呢支爽膚水（仲有埋 RL Cica 洗面奶）之後，用咗幾個禮拜，我就留意到現有暗瘡嘅泛紅有減退。用咗3個月之後，就算嚟m嗰陣都少咗好多暗瘡！自此我就一直用緊。

到依家我仲係日日用，冇再生過大暗瘡（間中會生細嘅，但已經好過之前嗰啲大瘡）。我仲將朋友都拉埋入坑用呢支。

整體嚟講，如果你好似我咁暗瘡嚴重，又試過其他想減少爆瘡嘅產品（信我，我試過 panoxyl、clean & clear 等等），試下呢個系列。佢溫和、有效，仲真係幫我淡化咗因為擠暗瘡而留下嘅色素沉澱。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Toner 250ml
reviews.text: Great toner to use not irritating at all unless when using active don’t do that because it does have an active in it. But good with other ingredients of other products. Very much underrated.
reviews.zh: 好正嘅爽膚水，唔會刺激，除非你搭配活性成分使用——唔好咁做，因為佢本身已經含有活性成分。不過同其他產品嘅其他成分一齊用就冇問題。非常被低估嘅產品。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Toner 250ml
reviews.text: When I’m telling you nothing helped my skin, I really mean it!! Until I came across this line from round lab. I really can’t believe my skin is getting better to the level where i can cry out of joy! These photos been taken 2 days apart only! The way my skin transformed is amazing!! I used the following products in this order (all from roundlab: birch juice cleanser, cica toner,cica ampule serum, cica cream. Morning and night. My face is not irritated, it is hydrated and doesn’t feel sticky or greasy afterwards and is not oily at all, just perfect and refreshed. Great products:)
reviews.zh: 當我同你講咩都幫唔到我塊皮膚，我係認真㗎！！直到我發現 round lab 呢個品牌。我真係唔敢相信我塊皮膚好轉到一個我忍唔住想喊嘅程度！呢啲相只係相隔兩日影嘅！皮膚嘅轉變簡直神奇！！我按以下次序用呢啲產品（全部都係 roundlab：birch juice cleanser、cica toner、cica ampule serum、cica cream），早晚都用。我塊面冇受刺激，保濕足夠，用完後唔覺得黏笠或者油笠，一啲都唔油，剛剛好又清新。超正嘅產品 :)

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Toner 250ml
reviews.text: I bought this toner for my combination and problem skin, as it contains Asian centella. I apply the toner after the foam, it moisturizes very well, as the foam from this series dries out the face. I hope it will help me. Thank you global olive young! 🫒😍♥️
reviews.zh: 因為見到呢支爽膚水含有亞洲積雪草，所以我買咗俾我混合性同有問題嘅皮膚用。我會喺洗面奶之後用爽膚水，保濕效果好好，因為同系列嘅洗面奶會令塊面變乾。希望佢幫到我。多謝 global olive young！🫒😍♥️

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Toner 250ml
reviews.text: exactly 12 days have passed since using this tool and the result is immediately noticeable! I would give this product 1000/10. In the first photo, you can see the products I used during these 12 days, I wiped my face with paper towels. I am 1000% satisfied
reviews.zh: 用咗呢件產品剛剛12日，效果即刻見到！我會俾1000/10分。第一張相可以見到我呢12日用過嘅產品，我用紙巾抹面。我係1000%滿意。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
